SELECT r.dst_apid, a.name
    FROM routes r
    JOIN airports a ON r.dst_apid = a.apid
    JOIN airlines a ON r.alid = a.alid
    WHERE r.src_apid IN ('CN') -- Assuming 'CN' is the code for China
    GROUP BY r.dst_apid
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
